name: cinnamon-chronos
description: Development tooling for Cinnamon Chronos, the Chronos Calendar Cinnamon applet: the test suites, the coverage gate and the linters. The applet itself ships from files/.
author: Geraldo Netto <geraldonetto@gmail.com> (https://github.com/geraldo-netto)

scripts.lint: npm run check:python-runtime && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: python3 -m pyflakes files/chronos@geraldo-netto scripts test || { status=$?; if python3 -c 'import pyflakes' 2>/dev/null; then exit $status; fi; echo 'pyflakes is not installed: pip install pyflakes (the Python lint is a gate, not an optional extra)'; exit 1; }
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
